description:
This package integrates Open Design Alliance ("ODA") CAD SDK v27.9 native binaries together with ThinkGeo-authored managed wrapper assemblies. It is a foundational dependency for ThinkGeo.Cad and is not intended to be referenced directly by application projects.

Includes:
- ThinkGeo wrapper assemblies (mixed-mode managed) for x64 and x86 under lib/win-<rid>/<tfm>/
- Open Design Alliance SDK v27.9 native binaries (Drawings, BimRv, IFC, PRC, DWF, DGN, etc.) under nativedlls/

Supported Platforms: Windows x64, Windows x86. Minimum OS: Windows 10 / Windows Server 2016. For Linux x64, add ThinkGeo.Cad.Dependency.Linux.

Note: The ODA SDK binaries are proprietary and are redistributed under ODA's Publishing License and Copyright terms (https://docs.opendesign.com/tp/publish_license_copyright.html). They may only be redistributed as part of a finished application. See LICENSE.txt and README.md inside the package for details.
title: ThinkGeo Cad Dependency for Windows
